description: Fields of the run record (state.md#2.8), local/runs/<run-id>/run.json.

id.description: The run id, for example r-20261126-1402-7q.

subject.description: Empty for a workflow with no subject.

session.description: The session id from the survey's caller marker.

ended.description: ISO 8601, UTC; empty while the run is live.

parent.description: The parent run's id; empty for a top-level run.

stories.description: Ids of the stories admitted to the run, by the survey or by an admission command.

request.description: The request or question the run was given: a request id, or the spike question.

amendment.description: True when the run holds an amendment.
